violations.text: The door to the outside, located in the main entrance, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 08/12/2026
Prep unit #1 was observed non-operational and in poor repair. Per PIC, part has been ordered. New Violation. Correct By: 08/19/2026

-Boba, and ice crem mix was observed held between 48-51 degrees Fahrenheit in the 2 door reach-in. -Milk was observed at 47 DF in the bottom of the prep unit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. All food was voluntarily disposed of at the time of inspection. PIC called for service at the time of inspection. Establishment is not to store any TCS foods in right side of 2 door reach-in, and prep unit until they are able to maintain and ambient temperature of 41 DF or less. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/05/2026

The door to the outside, located in the main entrance, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 08/12/2026

The 2 door reach-in was observed holding an ambient temperature of 46 DF and in poor repair -The prep unit was observed holding an ambient temperature of 51 DF and in poor repair Equipment must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 08/05/2026
Establishment is lacking a drain plug for the rinse compartment of the 3-bay sink. Establishment is to obtain drain plug. New Violation. Correct By: 08/05/2026
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the quat sanitizing solution for the 3-bay sink. Establishment is to obtain test strips. New Violation. Correct By: 08/07/2026

The following non-food contact surfaces have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. -Ice machine -Dry storage shelves -Refrigeration units/shelving Non-food contact surfaces must be cleaned to sight and touch. New Violation. Correct By: 08/05/2026
The ceiling in the prep area is covered with tiles that are not smooth, durable, and easily cleanable. New Violation. Correct By: 12/22/2023
